means: An extreme wide lens that projects the world onto a bulge - straight lines curve, the centre of frame swells forward, the edges compress and fall away.
does: Genuinely bends the picture, and it is the strongest geometry tag in this whole set. Three separate cards carry a fisheye option and all three panels show the same unmistakable effect: the horizon and the stadium bowl curve right around the subject and the middle of the frame pushes toward you. The cost is coherence - distortion drags anatomy and architecture with it, and in the same sweep the neighbouring strong_barrel panel is a mangled structure floating in a warped sky. Use it for a beat, not for a sequence.
reach_for_it: panic, a blow to the head, comedy, a character overwhelmed by a space. Anything where the world itself should feel wrong rather than merely tilted.
used_in: three cards carry it - shot.lens.look, shot.lens.distortion and shot.comp.perspective - which the project's review flags as one effect with three owners; shot.lens.distortion is the recommended single owner
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short dark hair, plain jacket, standing, city street, daytime
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
